Written for his four daughters — shared for every family.

Written for four daughters.
Meant for every journey.

Some things a father wants to say can't wait for the perfect moment — so Justin Matthew wrote them down. Dad's Life Lessons gathers the guidance he most wants his daughters to hold onto: how to trust God when life is uncertain, how to know their worth, and how to keep going when things get hard.

Each short, honest lesson is written the way a dad talks at the kitchen table — warm, direct, and rooted in faith. There are no lectures here, just encouragement meant to be returned to again and again: before a big decision, after a disappointment, or on an ordinary day when a daughter needs reminding of who she is.

Whether you're a parent looking for the right words, or a daughter, son, or young reader building a meaningful life, this is a book to keep close — and to give away.

“To help them face challenges with courage, recognize their worth, and build meaningful lives.”

— Justin Matthew, on why he wrote it

What's inside the book

Five themes run through Volume 1 — the lessons Justin returns to most often with his daughters. Tap a theme to read more.

When plans fall apart and answers don't come quickly, faith is what steadies you. These lessons explore trusting God's timing, praying through doubt, and holding on to hope when the road ahead isn't clear.

Focus: trusting God's timing, praying through doubt, holding on to hope.

Your worth was never up for a vote. This section helps readers quiet comparison, speak about themselves with kindness, and walk into rooms — and relationships — knowing they belong there.

Focus: quieting comparison, self-respect, staying true to yourself.

Mistakes are tuition, not a verdict. These lessons reframe failure as part of growing up — how to own what went wrong, ask for help, forgive yourself, and get back up wiser than before.

Focus: learning from mistakes, asking for help, getting back up.

From friendships to family to future partners, healthy love looks like honesty, patience, and respect — for others and for yourself. A gentle guide to choosing people who choose you back.

Focus: kindness, honesty, respect, and healthy boundaries.

Small choices, made on purpose, become a life. The closing lessons are about slowing down, weighing decisions against your values, and practicing gratitude for the ordinary good already around you.

Focus: thoughtful decisions, gratitude, living with intention.

The story behind the book

Justin Matthew wrote Dad's Life Lessons for his daughters — as a lasting reminder of his love, faith, and guidance that they can return to at any point in their lives, wherever life takes them.

Through heartfelt advice, he hopes to help them face challenges with courage, recognize their worth, and build meaningful lives. That hope is what fills every page of Volume 1 — and what the upcoming courses and programs will carry further.
